description: Modules that hold an SVG sink and must sit behind the sanitiser
rule: src/icons/svg-sanitize.ts is statically imported in every chunk that holds an SVG sink, or in a chunk on every chain of parent chunks from magic-card.js to it; never only in a sibling or behind its own import(). tools/check-svg-sinks.mjs finds sinks by scanning src (unsafeSVG, or a value import of svg-sanitize) and adds the modules below.
